prompt: Single game hero sprite: A hunched, thin old thunder mage about 2.5 heads tall (small head, huge flowing white beard drawn as two or three flat layered shapes, long sleeves, short legs), wearing a long deep indigo robe and a wide pointed indigo hat; one tall ancient gnarled wooden staff of dark knotted brown wood with a forked two-pronged top stands upright in his right hand, with one flat bright electric yellow lightning-bolt shape between the two prongs, the staff reaching about as high as the hat tip; saturated deep indigo main colour, bright electric yellow accent, brown wood, white beard. SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera: facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the screen, the body turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer so the face and the front of the chest are visible, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body. Not a flat profile, not a front view, not a diagonal three-quarter view toward the bottom-right. Standing UPRIGHT in a calm neutral idle stance: the body vertical, not leaning and not walking diagonally, both feet side by side on ONE horizontal ground line, the weapon held at rest (lowered or upright in front of the body, not raised to strike), a shield or off-hand item held at the side. Full body, centered, filling about 70% of the frame. The face is only a brow line and a small eye slit; hands are simple mitten shapes, visible and holding the weapon (not hidden in sleeves). No buckles, no pouches, no straps beyond one, no rope, no bandages, no spikes, no stitches, no patches, no fabric texture: clothing is a few big flat shapes. At most three colour families. The weapon and every part of the body stay inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail. Stylized, exaggerated cartoon proportions, not realistic anatomy (about 2.5 to 4 heads tall): the parts that express the character's role are enlarged and the rest is shrunk, so the silhouette reads at 60 pixels. Colour: flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. Effects (fire, ice, magic, poison, glow, energy) are drawn as stacked layers of flat single-colour vector shapes with an outline that follows the effect's form (flame tongues, ice shards, drips, sparks), never as soft blur or gradient glow. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
